title: Boil Release
body:
Boil Release forms from Fire + Water. Choose a second nature at level 25 after revealing your first at level 10; Dust Release additionally requires a third nature revealed at level 100. Clan Kekkei Genkai holders cannot gain an elemental release.

Techniques:
Level 25: Scalding Spray (help scalding spray)
Level 45: Vapor Cloak Burst (help vapor cloak burst)
Level 70: Corrosive Steam Wave (help corrosive steam wave)
